text: At the Garrow Heights site yesterday, project manager Elin Marr told the Gazette that Stennis Bank financed the housing scheme. She said the lender approved the £18.4 million package in March after a six-week review, allowing work to begin on the first 42 homes in the development off Quarry Lane. On a walk-through of the site, I saw foundations laid for nine terraced blocks and steel frames rising on the eastern plot. Site foreman Jon Vale said the money had already covered drainage, road access and the first phase of utilities. A spokesman for Stennis Bank, reached by phone, confirmed its backing of the scheme and said the loan was arranged through its regional housing desk.
